The '''Dronseen system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Thrasybule sector/Legends|Thrasybule sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dronseen]].
